339-677-955-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-955-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-849-2738-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Anax, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2510-3532-5078-7811.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-5078-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-4679-6821-7747.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-4496-5220-6794.description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

341-2034-4871-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Umori.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7511.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
6797-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4872-6927-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Damage Control Crew
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-4050-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4050-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2103-5144-5913.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and exiling Ephemerate.
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-997-2079-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

539-1308-3899-4241-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

427-478-539--111.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn three or more cards this turn.
427-478-539--111.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Kydele.
Repeat.

813-1777-3605-6915-6916.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Corpse Churn by paying {1}{B}, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Dance of the Dead from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{B} and exiling three cards not used in the combo, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Repeat.

856-4231-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3327-4419-4613-5073.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3327-4419-4613-5073.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

224-765-1772-5478.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

560-1940-4050-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-1940-4050-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding two mana of any color.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

645-1267-3908-4050.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3908-4050.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

1247-3443-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Deathbloom Ritualist and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-3443-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Deathbloom Ritualist's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1339-5905-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-5905-6092.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Warleader's Call triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a number of cards equal to the damage dealt.
Repeat from step 2.
1339-5905-6092.notes: You must stop the combo at some point before you draw from an empty library to prevent losing the game by accident, assuming an opponent survives until that point.

944-2908-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2082-2438-4186.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Scurry Oak.
2082-2438-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2082-2438-4186.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

526-2959-4200.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken non-Warrior creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-2959-4200.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Icewind Stalwart.
When the Icewind Stalwart token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Warrior you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Icewind Stalwart token.
Repeat from step 2.

2143-4434-4762-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
"Treefolk" chosen with Conspiracy.
2143-4434-4762-4875.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When the Eldrazi Spawns enter the battlefield as Treefolk due to Conspiracy, Quickbeam triggers twice, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +4/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

230-803-853-2757.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has a card in exile.
You control a basic Forest.
"Rat" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
230-803-853-2757.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
When the Eldrazi Scion enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Lord Skitter's first ability triggers, exiling a card from an opponent's graveyard.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Scion, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

830-1218-1819.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
830-1218-1819.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Syr Konrad +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Bone Harvest by paying {2}{B}, putting at least ten creature cards on top of your library from your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

608-2034-4067-4216.description:
Activate Folio of Fancies by paying {2} and taping it, causing each player to draw a card.
Xyris triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake token for each card that opponent drew.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Folio of Fancies.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a 1/1 Snake token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

618-2645-4299-5313.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight additional creatures.
618-2645-4299-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Dwarven Priest with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 12 life.
Pay 12 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Pay {1} to untap Staff of Domination and {3} and tap Staff of Domination to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

168-736-4753-5290.description:
Cast Copy Enchantment by paying {2}{U}.
Copy Enchantment enters the battlefield as a copy of Oblivion Ring, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Copy Enchantment's trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring until it leaves the battlefield.
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield as a copy of Copy Enchantment, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator's trigger, exiling Copy Enchantment until it leaves the battlefield.
Copy Enchantment leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Sage of Mysteries and Oblivion Ring trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring's trigger, exiling Clever Impersonator.
Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, returning Copy Enchantment from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
